```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Select the predictors for the initial model
model_data <- training_data %>%
  select(
    Goals,
    HomeAway,
    TeamRankCategory,
    OpponentRankCategory,
    Round,
    OpponentRound,
    Days,
    DWF,
    DLF,
    DDF,
    DAS,
    DDS,
    DRF,
    DYF,
    DFF,
    DCS,
    DSTF,
    DSF
  )

poisson_model <- glm(
  Goals ~ .,
  data = model_data,
  family = poisson(link = "log")
)

summary(poisson_model)

model_data$predicted_goals <- predict(
  poisson_model,
  newdata = model_data,
  type = "response"
)

mae <- mean(
  abs(model_data$Goals - model_data$predicted_goals)
)

rmse <- sqrt(
  mean((model_data$Goals - model_data$predicted_goals)^2)
)

mae
rmse
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

train_data <- training_data %>%
  filter(Year != "2024/25")

validation_data <- training_data %>%
  filter(Year == "2024/25")
```

```{r}
model_data <- training_data %>%
  select(
    Goals,
    HomeAway,
    TeamRankCategory,
    OpponentRankCategory,
    Round,
    OpponentRound,
    Days,
    DWF,
    DLF,
    DDF,
    DAS,
    DDS,
    DRF,
    DYF,
    DFF,
    DCS,
    DSF
  )

poisson_model <- glm(
  Goals ~ .,
  data = model_data,
  family = poisson(link = "log")
)

validation_data <- validation_data %>%
  mutate(
    predicted_goals = predict(
      poisson_model,
      newdata = validation_data,
      type = "response"
    )
  )

mae <- mean(
  abs(validation_data$Goals - validation_data$predicted_goals)
)

rmse <- sqrt(
  mean((validation_data$Goals - validation_data$predicted_goals)^2)
)

mae
rmse
```

```{r}
library(xgboost)
library(dplyr)

predictors <- c(
  "HomeAway",
  "TeamRankCategory",
  "OpponentRankCategory",
  "Round",
  "OpponentRound",
  "Days",
  "DWF",
  "DLF",
  "DDF",
  "DAS",
  "DDS",
  "DRF",
  "DYF",
  "DFF",
  "DCS",
  "DSF"
)
```

```{r}
categorical_vars <- c(
  "HomeAway",
  "TeamRankCategory",
  "OpponentRankCategory"
)

for (v in categorical_vars) {
  train_data[[v]] <- factor(train_data[[v]])
  validation_data[[v]] <- factor(
    validation_data[[v]],
    levels = levels(train_data[[v]])
  )
}

x_train <- model.matrix(
  reformulate(predictors, response = NULL),
  data = train_data
)[, -1, drop = FALSE]

# Build validation matrix with the same columns
x_valid <- model.matrix(
  reformulate(predictors, response = NULL),
  data = validation_data
)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

xgb_model <- xgboost(
  data = x_train,
  label = train_data$Goals,
  objective = "count:poisson",
  nrounds = 400,
  max_depth = 6,
  eta = 0.01,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  verbose = 0
)

validation_data$predicted_xgb <- predict(
  xgb_model,
  newdata = x_valid
)
mae_xgb <- mean(
  abs(validation_data$Goals - validation_data$predicted_xgb)
)

rmse_xgb <- sqrt(
  mean(
    (validation_data$Goals - validation_data$predicted_xgb)^2
  )
)

mae_xgb
rmse_xgb
```
```{r}
tibble(
  Model = c("Poisson regression", "XGBoost"),
  MAE = c(
    mean(abs(validation_data$Goals -
               validation_data$predicted_goals)),
    mae_xgb
  ),
  RMSE = c(
    sqrt(mean((validation_data$Goals -
                 validation_data$predicted_goals)^2)),
    rmse_xgb
  )
)
```
```{r}
calculate_metrics <- function(actual, predicted) {
  data.frame(
    MAE = mean(abs(actual - predicted)),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2))
  )
}
```
```{r}
library(lightgbm)

# Convert predictors to numeric matrices, encoding categorical variables
x_train <- model.matrix(
  ~ . - 1,
  data = train_data[, predictors, drop = FALSE]
)

x_valid <- model.matrix(
  ~ . - 1,
  data = validation_data[, predictors, drop = FALSE]
)

# Ensure training and validation have the same columns
x_valid <- x_valid[, colnames(x_train), drop = FALSE]

# Create LightGBM datasets
lgb_train <- lgb.Dataset(
  data = x_train,
  label = train_data$Goals
)

lgb_valid <- lgb.Dataset(
  data = x_valid,
  label = validation_data$Goals
)

# Fit the model
set.seed(123)

lightgbm_model <- lgb.train(
  params = list(
    objective = "regression",
    metric = "rmse",
    learning_rate = 0.01,
    num_leaves = 15,
    max_depth = 6,
    verbosity = -1,
    num_threads = 2
  ),
  data = lgb_train,
  nrounds = 200
)

validation_data$lightgbm_predictions <- predict(
  lightgbm_model,
  x_valid
)

# Evaluate
lightgbm_metrics <- calculate_metrics(
  validation_data$Goals,
  lightgbm_predictions
)

lightgbm_metrics
```
